## Community Coordinated Modeling Center Database Of Notifications, Knowledge, Information ( CCMC DONKI )
## Message Type: Space Weather Notification - CMEs (Mars, OSIRIS-APEX)
##
## Message Issue Date: 2024-06-23T17:02:06Z
## Message ID: 20240623-AL-003
##
## Disclaimer: NOAA's Space Weather Prediction Center is the United States Government official source for space weather forecasts. This "Experimental Research Information" consists of preliminary NASA research products and should be interpreted and used accordingly.


## Summary:

Multiple CMEs have been detected as follows:
1: C-type CME detected by STEREO A / SOHO. 

Start time of the event: 2024-06-23T07:48Z.

Estimated speed: ~795 km/s.

Estimated opening half-angle: 29 deg.

Direction (lon./lat.): 83/-2 in Heliocentric Earth Equatorial coordinates.

Activity ID: 2024-06-23T07:48:00-CME-001

2: S-type CME detected by STEREO A / SOHO. 

Start time of the event: 2024-06-23T07:00Z.

Estimated speed: ~370 km/s.

Estimated opening half-angle: 27 deg.

Direction (lon./lat.): 78/4 in Heliocentric Earth Equatorial coordinates.

Activity ID: 2024-06-23T07:00:00-CME-001

3: S-type CME detected by STEREO A / SOHO. 

Start time of the event: 2024-06-23T09:36Z.

Estimated speed: ~337 km/s.

Estimated opening half-angle: 35 deg.

Direction (lon./lat.): 97/-6 in Heliocentric Earth Equatorial coordinates.

Activity ID: 2024-06-23T09:36:00-CME-001

Based on preliminary analysis by the Moon to Mars Space Weather Analysis Office and heliospheric modeling carried out at NASA Community Coordinated Modeling Center, it is estimated that the CMEs may impact Mars and OSIRIS-APEX. The leading edge of the CMEs may reach Mars at 2024-06-27T01:00Z and OSIRIS-APEX at 2024-06-25T22:14Z (plus minus 7 hours).

## Notes: 

The CME event (2024-06-23T07:00:00-CME-001) is associated with M2.4 flare from Active Region 13716 (N10W75) with ID 2024-06-23T06:16:00-FLR-001 which peaked at 2024-06-23T06:30Z.


SCORE CME typification system:
S-type: CMEs with speeds less than 500 km/s
C-type: Common 500-999 km/s
O-type: Occasional 1000-1999 km/s
R-type: Rare 2000-2999 km/s
ER-type: Extremely Rare >3000 km/s
